name: beehiiv
description: Beehiiv MCP server with 117 tools for publications, subscriptions, posts, statistics, automations, webhooks, referral programs and API v2.
long_description: Requires eligible Beehiiv API v2 access. Use a private API key or your own registered OAuth integration. All 47 writes require explicit confirmation; read-only exposes 70 reads. Post creation defaults to draft and reports asynchronous processing. API plan/scope permissions apply. Credentials are never bundled.

api_key.title: Beehiiv API v2 key
api_key.description: Private API key from Workspace Settings > API. Leave empty when using an OAuth token file. Never an account password.

tokens_file.title: Private OAuth token file
tokens_file.description: Optional absolute path to your own private authorized Beehiiv OAuth JSON. Never bundle this file.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed audience and delivery changes
allow_destructive.description: If disabled, refuse all 47 writes even when confirmed.
